grammar.summary: 本课以「事事不顺的一天」为线索，集中运用了现在分词作状语、as if 虚拟语气与时间状语从句，并出现 what 引导的名词性从句。重点体会叙事中如何用分词短语表现连续动作、用虚拟语气表达假设、用从句交代时间关系。

points.title: 现在分词作状语 (Present Participles as Adverbials)
points.explanation: 现在分词 (v-ing) 可作时间、原因、伴随状语，表示与主语为主动关系的动作。本课用分词短语描述一连串连锁反应中的伴随动作，使画面生动紧凑。

examples.en: While you are on the phone, the baby pulls the tablecloth off the table, smashing half your best crockery and cutting himself in the process.
examples.cn: 就在你接电话时，孩子把桌布从桌子上扯下来，将家中最好的陶瓷餐具半数摔碎，同时也弄伤了他自己。

examples.en: Seeing a cake flying through the air, a lorry driver who was drawing up alongside the car, pulled up all of a sudden.
examples.cn: 此时，一辆卡车正好从后边开到那辆汽车边上，司机看见一块蛋糕从天而降，紧急刹车。

examples.en: As she was thrown forward, the cake went right through the windscreen and landed on the road.
examples.cn: 她往前一冲，蛋糕从挡风玻璃飞了出去掉到马路上。

points.title: as if 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive with as if)
points.explanation: as if/as though 引导方式状语从句，当所述情况与事实相反（非真实假设）时用虚拟语气：be 动词统一用 were。本课用 as if a single unimportant event set up... 表「好像一件小事引起连锁反应」，与现在事实相反的假设。

examples.en: It is as if a single unimportant event set up a chain of reactions.
examples.cn: 好像是一件无关紧要的小事引起了一连串的连锁反应。

examples.en: As if this were not enough to reduce you to tears, your husband arrives, unexpectedly bringing three guests to dinner.
examples.cn: 好像这一切还不足以使你急得掉泪，你的丈夫接着回来了，事先没打招呼就带来3个客人吃饭。

points.title: what 引导的名词性从句 (Nominal Clauses with what)
points.explanation: what 在从句中既起连接作用又充当主语/宾语，相当于 the thing that。本课用 what was left of the cake 作 devoured 的宾语，使表达简洁。

examples.en: Only two stray dogs benefited from all this confusion, for they greedily devoured what was left of the cake.
examples.cn: 只有两只野狗从这一片混乱中得到好处，它们贪婪地吃掉了剩下的蛋糕。

examples.en: What invariably happens is that a great number of things choose to go wrong at precisely the same moment.
examples.cn: 情况经常是这样的，许许多多的事情都偏偏赶在同一时刻出问题。

exercises.q: It is as if a single unimportant event ______ up a chain of reactions.
______ a cake flying through the air, a lorry driver who was drawing up alongside the car, pulled up all of a sudden.
Only two stray dogs benefited from all this confusion, for they greedily devoured ______ was left of the cake.
下列哪个词与课文中 collide 的含义最接近？
用现在分词填空：While you are on the phone, the baby pulls the tablecloth off the table, ______ (smash) half your best crockery and cutting himself in the process.（写出 smash 的正确形式）
